title: Silicon carbide power modules
summary: Silicon carbide power modules used in EV traction inverters and high-power chargers.
bodyHtml:
What This Is

Silicon carbide devices switch faster and tolerate higher temperatures than silicon, which shrinks cooling and improves efficiency in traction inverters and fast chargers. Infineon, STMicroelectronics and Chinese entrants have expanded capacity sharply, and prices have fallen as 200mm substrates scale. The constraint has moved from device design to substrate supply and packaging.

Status

Attribute Value
Development stage Mass production
Estimated window 2023–2030
Confidence label Confident
Evidence Editorial synthesis of company, agency and press reporting
Compiled 18 November 2026

Related records

Investment Exposure

SiC adoption is a cost curve story; when substrate prices fall, the technology moves from premium to mainstream vehicles.

What Would Change The View

  • Substrate cost and 200mm transition.
  • Design wins in mid-price EVs.
  • Chinese capacity and pricing pressure.

Record Notes

Editorial brief, not an imported source note. Named milestones are drawn from company, agency and press reporting; forward dates are announced targets, not verified outcomes. No figure here is an audited statistic.
